productChannels.title: Your product across channels
productChannels.description: Preview the saved listing, then check its connection and feed records.

preview.title: Saved listing preview
preview.description: Illustrative preview from saved data. Actual placements and layouts vary.
preview.googleNote: Product information for a shopping result
preview.chatgptNote: Product information for an assistant’s product card

source.title: Catalog connection
source.unknownDescription: Open your integrations to review the catalog connection.

google.title: Google feed records
google.description: These are saved sync records, not a live Google check. A verified override confirms the supplemental update was merged, not that Google displays the product.
google.unavailable: Feed records could not be loaded. Open Google Shopping to check the connection.
google.unsupported: Supplemental Google sync is not available for this catalog source.
google.notConnected: Google Merchant Center is not connected to this catalog.
google.setup: The connection needs setup before product records can be sent.
google.ready: The connection is ready. No feed record has been saved for this product yet.

assistant.title: Assistant discovery
assistant.description: A preview does not confirm that ChatGPT has indexed or recommended this product. Keep product details complete and review your published discovery surfaces.
